name: The Mycosynth Gardens — "a copy of target nontoken artifact you control with mana value X" offers only the artifacts of that mana value
notes: "{X}, {T}: This land becomes a copy of target nontoken artifact you control with mana value X." Found by the self-copy audit unit (2026-11-18). The copy restriction read only the type words, so every nontoken artifact you control was offered whatever X was. With X = 2, Mind Stone (mana value 2) is offered and Sol Ring (1) is not; the opponent's Fellwar Stone (2) is not yours.
